description:
Director David Robert Mitchell and producer JJ Abrams sit down with Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Nikki Novak to talk about their suburban dinosaur action spectacular, 'The End of Oak Street'!  Mitchell talks about how childhood wonder inspired his script, Abrams talks about the technical expertise it took to create horrifying CGI dinosaurs in broad daylight, and they discuss what Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor brought to the crucial family dynamic as actors.  'The End of Oak Street' smashes into theaters August 14!
